send_intents.subject: Building inspectable analytics at Databuddy
send_intents.body:
Hi Databuddy team,

Your founding engineer role spans the dashboard, ingestion API, and ClickHouse-backed analytics, not just another Next.js interface. I particularly like that Databunny shows the query behind an answer; that kind of inspectability makes analytics useful rather than opaque.

At Stride AI, I built React features and backend APIs end to end, including a schema-driven Page Studio with preview and publishing. I enjoy owning the boundary between product UI, data models, and production behavior, and I'm comfortable working asynchronously from India.

Could you consider my work for the founding engineer role?

Devansh
https://devansh.aurat.ai
https://github.com/8dazo
send_intents.eligibility_evidence: Official careers says remote, work from anywhere, async team spread across timezones.
send_intents.fit: TypeScript monorepo, Next.js, API, ingestion, ClickHouse, observability; user shipped Page Studio, production APIs/UI
send_intents.message_quality_angle: Grounded in Databunny SQL transparency and ClickHouse ingestion; Page Studio proof instead of agent-budget proof.
